description: host_mode=bypass_all + guild_gates=ask on a release gate MUST STILL require the Guild gate. host autonomy never implies gate autonomy (orthogonality invariant, ADR ~1348/1602). A resolver that returns gate_required=false here FAILS the invariant.

expected.reason: host bypass (bypass_all) never skips a Guild gate unless guild_gates explicitly permits that gate type; guild_gates=ask permits nothing
